definitions.active_route_t3v: active_route reacts to published state only: Volcano WARNING / visible floor flow (flow_heat > 0) -> starting roof via the authored route, back down once the flow is over; TerrainCollapse marked district containing the bot -> leave it (>= 2.0 m outside) before the deadline, never route through a marked or removed district; if its roof/shelter district is marked or removed, Flood/Volcano -> nearest other authored climb (pad >= 1.2 m lava / 3.7 m flood). Diagnostics: runs[].route T3v a2 (attentive layer, published state only): steps out of / does not walk into warned Meteor, Lightning and Earthquake footprints, the visible Tornado core and lane, and the breakable roof panels while a quake or meteor threatens them; roof/shelter stand points keep 1.5 m from the panels; bees: shelter, a loop on the roof, or nearest cover / away from the swarm; re-goals after being knocked off; waits on high ground above flood water before leaving a marked district while time allows. Diagnostics: runs[].route.dodge_log
definitions.death: shadow HP: first time cumulative requested damage reaches 100 (real elimination if --real-death)

official_fields.runs[].camp_broken_by_360 / camp_untouch: from first_relocation_3s_by_360 and HP lost by 6:00
official_fields.runs[].damage_by_disaster: requested damage to shadow death, keyed by attributed disaster (D3); raw: damage_by_cause, per event: damage_attributions
official_fields.runs[].death_time / death_cause / death_: shadow death; death_cause is the raw game cause, death_disaster the attributed disaster or 'Unattributed (<cause>)' (D3)
official_fields.runs[].first_relocation_3s_by_360: start of first >= 3 s off-roof episode before 6:00 while shadow-alive, -1 if none (D1)
official_fields.runs[].relocations / runs[].forced_reloc: off-starting-roof episodes >= 3 s while shadow-alive; an episode open at death is cut at death (D1); post-death: runs[].post_death_relocations / post_death_forced_relocations (diagnostic)
official_fields.runs[].starts_by_name: disaster starts up to and including the shadow-death frame (D2); post-death starts: runs[].post_death_starts_by_name (diagnostic)
official_fields.summary[group].per_disaster[name].starts: official rollups of the fields above (alive-only)

definitions.physics_space: map bodies re-inserted into the physics space in one frame after preparation (D4)
